# Formatting

## Emphasis

**bold**, *italic*, _italic too_, ***bold italic***, ~~strikethrough~~, ==highlight==, `inline code`.
Escaped \*not italic\* and a literal \`backtick\`.

## Links

Wikilink [[Welcome]], aliased [[Welcome|home page]], heading [[Lists#Tasks]], block [[Code#^snippet]],
unresolved [[Does not exist]], markdown [link](Welcome.md), external [Obsidian](https://obsidian.md),
bare URL https://example.com/path?q=1 and <https://autolink.example>.

## Tags

#tag #nested/tag #with-dash_and_underscore but not #123 and not a#b.

## Other

Inline math $e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0$ and a footnote[^1] and an inline one^[inline note].
%%a comment that only shows in editing%%
<kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>O</kbd>, H<sub>2</sub>O, line<br>break.

[^1]: The footnote text.
